messages:
sam (AE): Quantive wants a 45-day pilot but needs an exec signoff for temporary BYO-KMS access + an egress ceiling. Legal flagged indemnity and SSO requirements. Need quick internal decision so we don't miss their launch window.

harper (Sales Eng): They said production traffic will be ~3k reqs/min during peak tests. BYO-KMS is non-negotiable for their compliance team. They also asked for a provisional SLA (99.9) for the pilot window.

ravi (Solutions Eng): Technical reality: BYO-KMS for key unwrap is fine but requires extra onboarding (key rotation policy, CIP). Ops needs 48h to validate HSM integration. 99.9 for a pilot is high — we can offer a best-effort SLA with monitoring and an incident contact.

june (Security): BYO-KMS adds controls we like, but we need an architecture diagram and confirmation that keys never leave the HSM and we only receive wrapped keys. Also require annual SOC report acceptance clause for the trial. I can prepare a short checklist addendum.

marco (Legal): For indemnity and SLA language we'll need exact pilot boundaries, egress cap, and who signs on Quantive side. If they want higher SLA we should add credits, but for 45-day pilots we typically don't grant financial credits. Could do limited liability and termination on material breach.

ella (CRO): My preference: keep the pilot friction low. I'm okay to provide a provisional exec note allowing BYO-KMS onboarding and a one-off elevated monitoring cadence if Legal and Security confirm the addendum. No formal SLA credits. @marco @june please produce artifacts by EOD.

ops-bot: created ticket #4987 (quantive-byo-kms-pilot). Assigned: eng-infra, security, legal.

harper (Sales Eng): Quantive also wants a $0-$5k pilot credit band and clear pricing if we scale after pilot. Will confirm exact numbers today.

ravi (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) I will produce an ops runbook for BYO-KMS onboarding and a staging test checklist, 2) ops team to validate HSM unwrap within 48h, 3) implement egress throttle: cap at 10M tokens or $15k, auto-suspend on hit.

june (Security): I'll draft the security addendum with: key handling requirements, required SOC report, access controls, and mandatory PII masking.

marco (Legal): I'll draft the pilot addendum with limited liability, termination on PII exposure, and acceptance statement from Quantive. Need contact and org-level signer.

sam (AE): Great — I'll collect Quantive's signer and confirm the $5k credit ask. Will update this thread once I have their acceptance.

ella (CRO): Provisional exec ok contingent on legal + security addendum and ops test passing. If any red flags, we stop. :thumbsup:
